items.title: 14.2.8 Work done By a Constant Force (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab dot product ka sab se mashhoor istemal: physics mein work (kaam). Roz marra zindagi mein hum har mehnat ko "kaam" keh dete hain, lekin physics mein work ka matlab khaas hai: jab force kisi cheez ko harkat de, aur woh harkat force ki simt mein ho. Dot product bilkul isi "simt mein hissa" ko naapta hai, is liye work ka formula khud ba khud dot product ban jata hai.

Agar ek constant (na badalne wali) force \(\underline{F}\) kisi jism (body) par harkat ki simt se \(\theta\) angle par lage, to \(\underline{F}\) ka work yun define hota hai: displacement ki simt mein \(\underline{F}\) ka component, guna woh faasla jo jism tay karta hai.
Figure mein ek constant force \(\underline{F}\) jism ko \(A\) se \(B\) tak le jati hai.

blocks.alt: A block on a rough floor at position A is pulled by a force F at angle theta above the horizontal. A dashed vertical line drops from the tip of F, and a horizontal arrow shows the component of F along the motion, labelled magnitude of F times cos theta. A dashed outline shows the block at B, and the displacement d from A to B is marked below.
blocks.caption: Figure: a constant force F at angle θ to the motion moves a body from A to B (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Sirf component kyun? Force ka jo hissa harkat ke aar paar hai (figure mein upar wala hissa \(|\underline{F}|\sin\theta\)), woh jism ko aage nahin barhata, is liye koi work nahin karta. Sirf \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta\), yani displacement par \(\underline{F}\) ki projection (14.2.3), kaam ki hai. Ise faasle \(|\underline{d}|\) se multiply karein to:
\[W = |\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\cos\theta = \underline{F} \cdot \underline{d}\]
Yani work ek dot product hai.
Khaas soortein: \(\theta = 0\) par \(W = |\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\) (sab se zyada, saari force aage); \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\) par \(W = 0\) (misaal: bag utha kar seedhe chalna, bag par aap ki force upar hai aur harkat aage, is liye physics ke hisaab se aap bag par koi work nahin kar rahe!); aur obtuse \(\theta\) par work negative (force harkat ke khilaaf, jaise friction).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari practice, kitab ka sawal nahin.) \(\underline{F} = 3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j}\) newton ki force ek jism ko \(\underline{d} = 5\underline{i}\) metre le jati hai.
\[W = (3)(5) + (4)(0) = 15\ \text{joules (Nm)}\]
Tasdeeq angle se: \(|\underline{F}| = 5\), \(\cos\theta = \frac{3}{5}\), to \(W = 5 \times 5 \times \frac{3}{5} = 15\). Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain. Force ka \(4\underline{j}\) wala hissa harkat ke perpendicular hai, is liye us ne koi work nahin kiya.

blocks.title: Example 14
blocks.problem: The constant forces \(2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\) and \(-\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) acting on a body, displaced form position \(P(4, -3, -2)\) to \(Q(6, 1, -3)\). Find the total work done.
steps:
Given: forces \(\underline{F}_{1} = 2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{F}_{2} = -\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\); jism \(P(4, -3, -2)\) se \(Q(6, 1, -3)\) tak jata hai.
To find: kul (total) work.
Method: do forces ek saath lag rahi hain, is liye pehle unhein jama kar ke ek kul force \(\underline{F}\) banayenge (resultant). Phir displacement \(\underline{d} = \overrightarrow{PQ}\) nikaalenge (aakhri point minus pehla point). Aakhir mein \(W = \underline{F} \cdot \underline{d}\).

Step 1: Kul force
\[\underline{F} = (2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}) + (-\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
\[= \underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\]
Kyun: ek saath lagne wali forces vectors ki tarah jama hoti hain: \(2 - 1 = 1\), \(5 - 2 = 3\), \(6 - 1 = 5\). (Alag alag work nikaal kar jama karein to bhi yahi jawab aayega, distributive property ki wajah se.)

Step 2: Displacement
\[\underline{d} = \overrightarrow{PQ} = (6 - 4)\underline{i} + (1 + 3)\underline{j} + (-3 + 2)\underline{k}\]
\[= 2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) = \(Q\) ka position vector minus \(P\) ka position vector. Dhyan dein: \(1 - (-3) = 1 + 3 = 4\) aur \(-3 - (-2) = -3 + 2 = -1\); minus minus ka plus banana mat bhooliye.

Step 3: Work
\[W = \underline{F} \cdot \underline{d} = (\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}) \cdot (2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
\[= (1)(2) + (3)(4) + (5)(-1)\]
\[= 2 + 12 - 5 = 9\]
Kyun: work = force dot displacement. Jawab ek number hai, kyun ke work scalar quantity hai; us ki koi simt nahin hoti.

Tasdeeq:
Har force ka work alag nikaal kar jama karte hain: \(\underline{F}_{1} \cdot \underline{d} = 4 + 20 - 6 = 18\), \(\underline{F}_{2} \cdot \underline{d} = -2 - 8 + 1 = -9\). Kul \(18 - 9 = 9\). Wahi jawab! (Doosri force ka work negative hai kyun ke woh zyada tar harkat ke khilaaf lag rahi hai.)
blocks.answer: Kul work \(= 9\) units (kitab \(9\) Nm likhti hai, yani force newton mein aur faasla metre mein maan kar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 14 ke sawal mein "displaced form position" chhapa hai; sahi "displaced from position" hai (form nahin, from).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar jism \(Q\) se wapas \(P\) par aa jaye aur forces wahi rahein, to is wapsi ke safar mein work kitna hoga? Sochiye: displacement ulat kar \(-\underline{d}\) ho jayega, is liye \(W = \underline{F} \cdot (-\underline{d}) = -9\). Aur poore chakkar (\(P\) se \(Q\) aur wapas \(P\)) ka kul work \(9 - 9 = 0\).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Constant force ka work: \(W = \underline{F} \cdot \underline{d} = |\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\cos\theta\).
2. Kai forces hon to pehle jama karein (ya har ek ka work nikaal kar jama karein); jawab ek hi aata hai.
3. Displacement \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) = aakhri point minus pehla point.
4. Work scalar hai; force newton aur faasla metre mein ho to unit Nm (joule).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) ko \(P - Q\) le lena; sahi \(Q - P\) hai (aakhri minus pehla).
2. Displacement ki jagah \(Q\) ka position vector istemal kar lena.
3. Work ko vector likh dena; work sirf ek number hai.
4. Sirf ek force ka work nikaal kar ruk jana jab sawal "total work" maang raha ho.
